title: Tidal flow dynamics and background fluorescence of the Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway in the vicinity of Sullivan's Island and the Isle of Palms, South Carolina, 2011-12
citation: Conrads, P.A., Journey, C.A., Clark, J.M., and Levesque, V.A., 2013, Tidal flow dynamics and background fluorescence of the Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway in the vicinity of Sullivan's Island and the Isle of Palms, South Carolina, 2011-12: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-2013-1077, map scale 1:71,400.
notes: Surface-water study: tidal flow (index-velocity stations IOP, SI, BI) and water quality / background rhodamine fluorescence in the Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway near Sullivan's Island and Isle of Palms, Charleston County, 2011-12. It describes no geologic units, borings, wells, outcrops, structures or aquifers; the monitoring stations are surface-water gages and water-quality profile points, which are not observation kinds in the extraction schema. The reference list (p. 28) contains only methods and instrument references (index-velocity method, ADCP, YSI sondes, IDW, filtering, fluorometry), none on South Carolina geology, so none were recorded. Nothing to extract; recorded as complete with no values.
